description: June 12 birthday meaning: Gemini decan 3, birthday number 3, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a June 12 birthday falls in Gemini, in the third decan, with Mercury as the sign's ruler and Uranus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 3. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Gemini is mutable and air.

sections.heading: June 12 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Mid-June's Gemini, twenty-one degrees in, gets an electric edge from Uranus and an expressive one from 3. The 12th is often associated with original humour and a fondness for saying what others are thinking but have not yet phrased. Interpretive astrology pictures a quick, slightly contrary communicator whose best ideas tend to arrive mid-sentence.

On June 12 the Sun usually sits at about 21° Gemini, in the third decan, where Uranus is the sub-ruler alongside Mercury. The last third of Gemini carries Uranus as sub-ruler, the modern ruler of Aquarius, so this decan is usually read as the most inventive and unconventional stretch of the sign. Mid-June birthdays often come with a mind that leaps ahead, connects unlikely sources and enjoys questioning the obvious. Astrologers associate these natives with technology, reform and a detached, slightly futuristic way of seeing social life. The Uranian current can make routine feel unbearable and plans change at short notice. Grounding those flashes of insight in a few steady habits tends to let the originality land where others can use it.

sections.heading: June 12 in numerology
paragraphs: A birthday on the 12th reduces as 1 + 2 = 3, so the birthday number is 3, but the compound holds two stories at once. The 1 brings self-direction and the 2 brings cooperation, and together they produce the 3's expressive, sociable energy. Twelfth-of-the-month natives are often described as communicators who can lead a conversation and also make space for others in it. As with every day number, this is a secondary influence beside the Life Path. Its particular gift tends to be creative work that depends on teamwork, where one voice sets the tone and many voices fill it out.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one June 12 birthday to the next: it is 7 for 1960, 8 for 1970, 9 for 1980 and 1 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11.

sections.heading: Born on June 12: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: A June birthday falls at the height of northern summer, around the longest days of the year, while in the southern hemisphere it marks the darkest stretch near the winter solstice. Gemini covers most of the month, with Cancer beginning around June 21. June is month 6 in numerology, a number of care, responsibility and home, which foreshadows the Cancerian turn at the month's end. June 12 is the 163rd day of the year (164th in a leap year). By June 22, 10 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Cancer.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by June 12, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on June 12 include George H. W. Bush (1924), Anne Frank (1929) and Anthony Eden (1897).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is June 12?
faq.answer: June 12 is Gemini in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Gemini, which tradition links with Uranus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on June 12?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On June 12 the Life Path is 7 in 1960, 8 in 1970, 9 in 1980, 1 in 1990, 11 in 2000, 3 in 2010 and 4 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 3 for everyone born on the 12th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on June 12?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a June 12 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on June 12?
faq.answer: June 12 is also the birthday of George H. W. Bush (1924), Anne Frank (1929) and Anthony Eden (1897). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
